name: jevfort
description: Lets TypeSafe Jev take routine steps and route effort (port of nim-f/jev-pilot; asks Jev through the jev-api plugin's tools).

routing.title: Effort routing
routing.description: Choose the effort of every turn by Jev's estimate and show the effort row above the prompt. Off: turns run at the session effort and the effort row is hidden (the estimate_effort tool and the cache countdown stay).

takeSteps.title: Take steps
takeSteps.description: Let Jev make routine tool calls (Read, git, project scripts) instead of Claude.

takeThreshold.title: Take threshold
takeThreshold.description: Minimum probability for Jev to take a step itself.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Also route effort inside subagent loops, and take steps there when takeOnlyForBypass is off.

bypass.title: Answer simple prompts without Claude
bypass.description: When a prompt only needs one read-only action Jev takes (run the tests, git status, read a file), a small model reports the result and the main Claude model is skipped.

agentTypes.title: Pick subagent types
agentTypes.description: Let Jev switch a general-purpose subagent to a specialised type when it is confident.

compaction.title: Guide compaction
compaction.description: Before a compaction, tell the summarizer which earlier tool results to keep in detail.

haikuCompact.title: Compact with Haiku
haikuCompact.description: Haiku 5.5 writes every compaction summary (also /compact and the automatic one) at a fraction of the chat model's price; if it fails, Claude Code compacts as usual. It replaces Claude Code's own compaction step: PreCompact hooks do not run and recently read files are not re-attached.

autoCompactPercent.title: Auto-compact from context fill (%)
autoCompactPercent.description: When the prompt cache has gone cold and the context is at least this full, the idle chat is compacted by itself. 0 turns it off.

taskCompactPercent.title: Compact at task end from context fill (%)
taskCompactPercent.description: From this context fill, the first turn Jev judges to have closed a task (not an intermediate result) ends with a compaction. 0 turns it off.

forceCompactPercent.title: Force compaction from context fill (%)
forceCompactPercent.description: From this context fill, the next turn end compacts without asking Jev, when no task end came before. 0 turns it off.

takeOnlyForBypass.title: Take steps only for whole-turn answers
takeOnlyForBypass.description: Jev takes a step only when the whole prompt is one read-only action it can answer without Claude. Off: Jev may also take routine steps inside longer turns (measured to add turns without saving cost).

minEffort.title: Minimum effort
minEffort.description: Lowest effort Jev's turn-start effort estimate may pick; also the effort of a purely mechanical turn.

maxEffort.title: Maximum effort
maxEffort.description: Highest effort Jev's turn-start effort estimate may pick.
